text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Ah, you were very close. The claw machine is a tricky opponent indeed.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: There's no need to apologize. It's enough for me that you made the effort.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I hope you all find someone kind to take care of you, little plushies…
